objects.name: Chota Nagpur Banking Association Limited
objects.description: The mortgagee bank that held the first mortgage on Gadi Sirampur and later purchased a share in execution.

objects.name: Wazir Narain Singh
objects.description: The mortgagor who executed the mortgage in 1914 and subsequently granted a permanent lease in 1925.

objects.name: Hiraman Ram
objects.description: The lessee who took the permanent lease of four villages in 1925 as Manager and Karta of a joint Hindu family.

objects.name: Chohan Ram
objects.description: The son of Hiraman Ram who was named as a co-lessee in the permanent lease and later sued for possession.

objects.name: Gadi Sirampur
objects.description: The mortgaged estate comprising the villages Nawadih, Koldih, Pandna, and Chihutia, subject to the lease and mortgage disputes.

components.name: Nawadih
components.description: One of the four villages included in the permanent lease granted in 1925.

components.name: Koldih
components.description: One of the four villages included in the permanent lease granted in 1925.

components.name: Pandna
components.description: One of the four villages included in the permanent lease granted in 1925.

components.name: Chihutia
components.description: One of the four villages included in the permanent lease granted in 1925.

objects.name: Court of the Additional Subordinate Judge of Hazaribagh
objects.description: The trial court that passed the original decree in Title Suit No. 45 of 1939 in favor of the plaintiff.

objects.name: High Court of Judicature at Patna
objects.description: The appellate court that negatived the constructive res judicata contention and held the lease valid in 1944.

objects.name: Civil Appeal No. 73 of 1950
objects.description: The Privy Council appeal admitted in 1946 to determine if a mortgagor could grant a permanent lease before Section 65-A.

objects.name: Permanent Lease of 1925
objects.description: The registered Patta executed on November 5, 1925, granting four villages to Hiraman Ram and Chohan Ram.

objects.name: Mortgage Decree of 1921
objects.description: The decree passed on November 29, 1921, in the suit filed by the Bank against Wazir Narain Singh.

objects.name: Auction Sale of 1935
objects.description: The execution sale on April 6, 1935, where the plaintiff purchased Gadi Sirampur in favor of the Bank.
